messages.subject: rgl plots fail on macOS Tahoe 26
messages.subject_clean: rgl plots fail on macOS Tahoe 26
messages.body_plain:
Hi Greg and community,

Since rgl plotting with XQuartz broke with macOS Tahoe (https://github.com/dmurdoch/rgl/issues/488) I was wondering if anyone has found a solution for continuing to use rgl for 3D visualization of neurons with the natverse that doesn't require plotly? The suggestion

options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE, rgl.printRglwidget = TRUE)

isn't working for me.

best,
emil
